subject: Mobile Development
title: The Anti-Steering Rules
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Anti-Steering Rules usable.

hook.text: Apple banned apps from telling users they could buy cheaper subscriptions on the web.

buildup.text: These anti-steering provisions forced all purchases through Apple's payment system.

discovery.text: A US court ordered Apple to allow links to external payment methods in 2021.

twist.text: Apple complied technically but added a 27% commission on external purchases anyway.

climax.text: Anti-steering rules are the clearest example of platform power limiting developer freedom.

punchline.text: You can link out — but Apple still wants its cut.

quiz.question: What are anti-steering rules?
options: Rules banning apps from directing users to external purchase options
